title: Classes list stops flagging missing BPM; the builder track panel keeps it
acceptance: The Classes row no longer shows "no BPM set" in the caution channel; missing tempo does not read like a gap that needs action on the list.
The builder track panel still shows which tracks have no BPM.

Design system 10 §1a (name a gap rather than silently drop a stat) is reconciled in the PR: either the row keeps a neutral, non-caution mention, or §1a records the exception for tempo. The choice is stated in the PR.
GetSongBPM stays unprovisioned (owner deferral); no Spotify BPM path (permanent constraint).
nextAction: Files: apps/web/src/components/Dashboard.tsx (Classes row stats, around the "no BPM set" span) and ritmofit_design_system if §1a changes. Not owner-gated. Pairs with RF-134's tempo criterion. Surface: web; iOS only if the canon changes. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.
